basis.rows: Each row is a productivity-board product: a consumer or workspace assistant or a general agent, not a coding harness. Sources are vendor-controlled pages (a vendor site or the vendor's own App Store listing), read on checked_at.
basis.scores: None. The rows carry no score, metric or rank. Metrics are entered by a later reviewed change.
basis.status: Rows are inactive. Activation is a separate step, after 2026-11-01.

products.name: ChatGPT
products.description: OpenAI's assistant app for chat, research, files and agent tasks.

products.name: Gemini
products.description: Google's Gemini assistant app on web, Android and iOS.

products.name: Hermes Agent
products.description: Open-source, MIT-licensed agent with persistent memory, scheduled tasks and subagents, reachable from CLI and chat apps.

products.name: Microsoft Copilot
products.description: Microsoft's consumer Copilot assistant, bundled into Microsoft 365 Personal, Family and Premium.

products.name: Manus
products.description: General-purpose AI agent that builds slides, websites, games and designs from one prompt.

products.name: Genspark
products.description: AI workspace whose Super Agent runs tasks in a cloud sandbox and makes slides, sheets and docs.

products.name: Mistral Vibe
products.description: Mistral's unified agent for work and coding (the former Le Chat), with long-running tasks and connectors.

products.name: Notion AI
products.description: Notion's built-in AI teammate that works across pages, docs, tasks and databases.

products.name: Grok
products.description: xAI's Grok assistant app (separate row from the grok model family).
